Customer support is open Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00, and on Saturday
from 10:00 to 16:00. We are shut on Sunday and on every bank holiday.

Phone lines close 30 minutes before the counter does, and live chat is
staffed until 20:00 on weekdays.

The Birmingham showroom opens at 10:00 each weekday and closes at 17:30.
Outside those hours leave a voicemail and we ring back the next morning.
